name: student-feedback-writer
description: Write structured, honest, and constructive feedback for student work including master's theses, project reports, seminar presentations, and assignments. Calibrated for academic supervision — separates what is good from what needs work, and gives actionable direction without doing the work for the student. Triggers on: "write feedback for this thesis", "comment on this report", "how should I give feedback on", "draft supervision notes", "assess this student work", "write thesis examiner comments", "grade justification".
